cues.text: The dorm lounge. You study around the dining table with Yukari, Junpei, Fuuka, Akihiko and Ken, with Koromaru sitting by Ken. Mitsuru is not with you.
Ken, already on his feet, sits back down. Mitsuru stands a few steps from the table, watching the group.
Later, Mitsuru sits at the table with everyone, studying.
